'''Star Legends - Galactic Wars''' is a roleplaying game set in the Star Wars ''Legends'' universe, using a d100 system adapted from ''Warhammer Fantasy Roleplay'' 4th edition.

== How this wiki is organised ==
* Pages ending in <code>/Legends</code> are harvested from Wookieepedia (CC BY-SA 3.0) and carry the canon (Legends) facts.
* Pages starting with <code>SL100:</code> are our own game material: rules, careers, talents, and the game statistics (cost, availability, damage, etc.) for items, vehicles and creatures.
* Each game page links to the Legends page it is based on.
